Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Generate one independent native square monochrome editorial photograph of a fictional attractive52-year-old man with a southern European appearance, a long narrow face, aquiline nose, high receding hairline, short silver-brown hair, clean-shaven cheeks and natural forehead lines. He is a Roman Catholic priest. This is a new fictional identity, no reference images and no intended resemblance to a real person. Demographic wording is creative prompt intent.
Pose: turned slightly toward camera-right, reserved closed-lip smile. Attractive but real and individual, not a generic square-jawed fashion model.
Clothing: anatomically plausible neck and a correctly fitted black clerical shirt. A distinct clean white Roman collar TAB sits centrally inside the black standing collar at the throat; it must be fully visible, separated from the chin and beard, and clearly recognizable.
Background: plain neutral mid-gray, gently soft, no discernible architecture or objects. Lighting: restrained natural soft side-window illumination with realistic fill.
Framing: entire uncropped BARE HEAD including every hair tip, face central, both shoulders and upper chest. Generous visible space above head and around its sides; white tab and several inches of black shirt BELOW the collar fully within square. Eyes roughly42 percent from the top. Do not zoom tightly.
Photography: genuine-looking grayscale black-and-white, natural pores, wrinkles, individual hairs, realistic eyes, nose, ears and closed lips. Subtle facial asymmetry, believable anatomy, no beauty filter or plastic skin. Quiet editorial portrait, not glossy advertising.
Avoid: hats, head coverings, mitres, crowns, halos, hands, jewelry, props, other people, text, watermarks, architecture, visible teeth or open mouth, colored tint, collage or montage. One photo only.
